rationale: Browser automation requires bounded semantic selection only over an FA3-generated action space. Decision Fabric may select an observed candidate, but browser execution, permission, model routing, provider admission, resources, security and success verification remain with their existing FA3 authorities.

decision_points.purpose: select exactly one currently observed and runtime-authorized browser action candidate
decision_points.final_policy_owner: FA3-WEB-AI-001 / UAF / existing FA3 policy authorities

decision_points.purpose: provide a bounded stop/continue judgment when deterministic browser state alone is insufficient
